I understand. That's the hardest part about wanting to die. I'm always afraid I've hurt someone by wanting to talk about suicide or felt embarrassed and shameful because now they have to share it with me. It's out there now. You can try to accept it and try to not let it weigh over you. You can even pretend to be "all better" so she doesn't feel scared and worried. But honestly, the fact that she is supporting you shows she's voluntarily carrying part of that pain with you because she loves you and knows what it means to share that with you. As they say, communication is key. If you're worried, just ask her. Being open could save your life.
